fusions.name: Snare Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a ring around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles; each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Weighted Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted line at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 8 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach. Anything struck moves 15% slower for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Drawn Tight
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Knotted Odds
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying a condition, your damage rises by 12%.
